BUGFIX PAIR ROOM (captain 2026-09-08): every bug the captain found in the flow is dispatched through the bugfix-pair-room skill (one strong driver, one cheap coder, one cheap scout; root cause proven by a reproduction before any patch); until the skill lands on main, read the draft at data/bugfix-pair-room/SKILL.md.
